_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "extras" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "restaurant_tables" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "zone" TEXT NULL, "pos_x" INTEGER NULL, "pos_y" INTEGER NULL, "shape" TEXT NULL, "seats" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "floor_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "zone" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "pos_x" INTEGER NOT NULL, "pos_y" INTEGER NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NOT NULL, "height" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_id" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "order_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "extras" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sent_at" TEXT NULL, "ready_at" TEXT NULL, "served_at" TEXT NULL, "paid_qty" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lots" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "investment_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lot_sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lot_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "layaways" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "delivered_at" TEXT NULL, "refund_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "credit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "pay_every_days" INTEGER NULL, "reminded_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "layaway_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layaway_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "from_layaway_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "layaway_items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "layaway_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "qty" REAL NOT NULL, "unit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "suppliers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "purchases" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NULL, "lines" TEXT NOT NULL, "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "clerk" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "supplier_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplier_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "purchase_id" TEXT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "clerk" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_counts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lines" TEXT NOT NULL, "missing_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "extra_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "clerk" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "supplies_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "batch_orders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "detail" TEXT NULL, "total_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "delivery" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("paid" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "products" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "icon_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'otro', "track_stock" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("track_stock" IN (0, 1)), "stock" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "min_stock" REAL NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "photo_path" TEXT NULL, "sold_at" TEXT NULL, "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "size" TEXT NULL, "color" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "customers" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "credit_limit_cents" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sales" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "folio" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "received_cents" INTEGER NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NULL, "device" TEXT NULL, "order_id" TEXT NULL, "cancelled_at" TEXT NULL, "cancel_reason" TEXT NULL, "cancelled_in_session" TEXT NULL, "discount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "clerk_name" TEXT NULL, "tip_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_items" ("sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "line_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "qty" REAL NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("sale_id", "position"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_payments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "method" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "product_photos" ("path" TEXT NOT NULL, "product_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "uploaded" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("uploaded" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("path"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sale_returns" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "lines" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "cash_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "reason" TEXT NULL, "clerk" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "exchange_sale_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "credit_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "customer_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "sale_id" TEXT NULL, "method" TEXT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NULL, "clerk_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "opened_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "opening_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "closed_at" TEXT NULL, "expected_cents" INTEGER NULL, "counted_cents" INTEGER NULL, "device" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cash_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "concept" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "clerk_name" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
